summary: Backend-only testing for 42+ Home Fitness Comeback app. 13/13 pytest tests passed covering all requested endpoints: /api/health, /api/program, /api/sessions/{id}, /api/state, /api/state/week (with boundary validation), /api/logs CRUD, /api/logs/suggestion (start/hold/increase logic with +2.5kg), and /api/tts (generation + cache hit). Cache hit for TTS was ~sub-second confirming on-disk caching works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); consider migrating to lifespan handlers (non-blocking).
seed_data.py is 380+ lines of content; acceptable but consider splitting per-session if it grows further.
tts endpoint returns FileResponse without explicit filename header; fine for streaming but consider adding ETag for browser cache.
list_logs limit query param is not validated (could accept negative or huge values) - minor input validation gap.
Progressive overload suggestion uses only the most recent log; not a bug per spec but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: Test logs used TEST_ prefixed exercise_name and were cleaned up in the same test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Frontend testing not requested in this iteration. Reuse /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py for regression. TTS cache lives in /app/backend/tts_cache/.
